text: Implement SQL parser using tree-sitter-sequel 0.3 — CREATE TABLE/VIEW/FUNCTION/PROCEDURE → ExtractedClass/Function, TDD with 7+ unit tests, IPC integration test. See docs/decisions/2026-04-24-sql-grammar-spike.md for design mapping and effort estimate (~2 hours).

tree-sitter-sequel CREATE PROCEDURE support: grammar 0.3 produces ERROR nodes for CREATE PROCEDURE. When a future version supports it, update test_sql_procedure_graceful to expect 1 Function symbol instead of 0. Source: docs/closure/2026-04-26-034-F-sql-parser-closure.md

SQL parser: resolve FROM references to known Class nodes in graph. Currently emits References edges with raw identifier strings only; future work should resolve to indexed table Class nodes within the same workspace. Source: docs/closure/2026-04-26-034-F-sql-parser-closure.md

SQL parser: multi-schema reference support (schema.table syntax). Currently only simple identifier references extracted; schema.table patterns like FROM public.users not yet parsed. Source: docs/closure/2026-04-26-034-F-sql-parser-closure.md
